attributes.name: Tef-Naju
attributes.powers:
Tef-Naju is immune to the Electricity trait.

Before you act, if another character is at your location, each character at your location is dealt 1d4 Electricity damage.

If the result of the check to defeat is less than 35, check off the trader Trove of Tef-Naju on the Bazaar card.
